relations.name: file
relations.description: One package's observation of a source file. A path that two packages read has two rows; Atlas never picks an owner.

columns.name: path
columns.description: Path relative to the workspace root.

columns.name: package
columns.description: The Cargo package that reads the file.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: The package reads it only in a test build (a test target, or under a test module).

columns.name: fingerprint
columns.description: FNV-1a 64-bit content fingerprint; a change detector, not a security digest.

notes: Includes files no module declaration reaches (disconnected source): they have no mount row.

relations.name: mount
relations.description: A module path at which a package's Cargo target reaches a file through `mod` declarations.

columns.name: path
columns.description: The file, as in `file.path`.

columns.name: package
columns.description: The package, as in `file.package`.

columns.name: root
columns.description: The Cargo target root the path starts from.

columns.name: module_path
columns.description: Modules from the target root, joined with `::`; empty for the root file itself.

columns.name: target
columns.description: The Cargo target, when several share the root; empty when one target starts there (most rows), since the root then names it.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: The target or a module on the path requires a test build.

notes: A file can have several mounts (several targets, or `#[path]`), or none.

relations.name: declaration
relations.description: A declaration site: an item Atlas read at a file and line. Not a resolved Rust symbol.

columns.name: id
columns.description: `path:line:name`. A file two packages read gives the same id in each package.

columns.name: package
columns.description: The package whose observation of the file this is.

columns.name: path
columns.description: The file.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The declared name as written (for an impl, its written head).

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Fn, Struct, Enum, Union, Trait, TypeAlias, Mod, MacroRules, PubUse, Const, Static, Impl, Use, MacroCall or Extern; an unknown tag is kept verbatim.

columns.name: visibility
columns.description: Written visibility: Pub, PubCrate, PubIn, PubSuper or Private. Not Rust's effective visibility.

columns.name: line
columns.description: First line of the item, 1-based.

columns.name: end_line
columns.description: Last line of the item.

columns.name: inline_modules
columns.description: Enclosing inline `mod` blocks in the file, outermost first, joined with `::`; empty at file level.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: Inside a test module, or in a file the package reads only for tests.

notes: The key is (id, package). Count declarations per package observation, as `census` does.

relations.name: import
relations.description: A `use` declaration as written, per package observation of its file.

columns.name: path
columns.description: The file.

columns.name: package
columns.description: The package.

columns.name: written
columns.description: The `use` tree as written, without resolving it.

relations.name: mention
relations.description: A type name written in a declaration's signature or body, matched by spelling.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Mention id, unique within one export.

columns.name: source
columns.description: The declaration whose text holds the mention (`declaration.id`).

columns.name: spelling
columns.description: The identifier as written.

columns.name: evidence
columns.description: parameter-mention, return-mention or type-body-mention.

notes: Approximate: a spelling match, not compiler name resolution.

relations.name: mention_target
relations.description: A declaration a mention's spelling can name. An ambiguous mention has one row per candidate.

columns.name: mention
columns.description: The mention (`mention.id`).

columns.name: target
columns.description: A candidate declaration (`declaration.id`).

columns.name: basis
columns.description: `unique` when the spelling names one declaration; `candidate` when it names several and this is one of them.

notes: A `unique` basis is a unique spelling match, not proof that Rust resolves the name there.

relations.name: mention_unresolved
relations.description: A mention whose spelling Atlas could not match to a workspace declaration.

columns.name: mention
columns.description: The mention (`mention.id`).

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why it is unresolved, as Atlas reports it.

relations.name: diagnostic
relations.description: An observation Atlas could not complete while reading the source.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: path
columns.description: The file.

columns.name: line
columns.description: The line, or 0 when the diagnostic is about the whole file.

columns.name: package
columns.description: The package whose observation it is, or empty for the physical file.

columns.name: message
columns.description: The diagnostic as written in Atlas's other output; its wording may change.

columns.name: code
columns.description: Its kind, a stable code such as `mount-missing` (see the code list).

relations.name: qualified_file
relations.description: A file the qualified analysis read.

columns.name: path
columns.description: The file.

columns.name: fingerprint
columns.description: Content fingerprint of the bytes analyzed.

notes: Production source by default: test targets, test modules and test-gated items are read only with --with-tests, and each row from them is marked test_only.

relations.name: function
relations.description: A function body the qualified analysis selected.

columns.name: id
columns.description: `path:line:column` of the item.

columns.name: path
columns.description: The file.

columns.name: line
columns.description: First line of the item.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The name as written, with the impl type for a method (`Type::name`).

columns.name: qualified
columns.description: The name with the inline `mod` blocks that enclose it, and the owner type for a method (`Snapshot::graph`); the file's own module path is `mount.module_path`, one per Cargo target that reaches the file.

columns.name: signature
columns.description: The signature as written.

columns.name: public
columns.description: Written `pub` with no restriction. `pub(crate)`, `pub(super)`, `pub(in path)` and private are false, and so is a trait impl's method, which has the trait's visibility.

columns.name: trait_impl
columns.description: Declared in a trait impl.

columns.name: declaration
columns.description: The lexical `declaration.id` at the same file, line and name; empty if none matched.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: In a test-only file, a test module, or behind a test gate. Always false unless the capture includes tests (`--with-tests`).

columns.name: lines
columns.description: Code lines in the body, as Clippy's too_many_lines counts them: lines holding code outside comments, the outer braces left out. The concentration law's measure.

columns.name: nesting
columns.description: The deepest block level inside the function, counted from the file's root as Clippy's excessive_nesting counts it. Blocks inside macro arguments are not counted.

relations.name: type
relations.description: A workspace struct, enum or type alias.

columns.name: id
columns.description: `path:line:column` of the item.

columns.name: path
columns.description: The file.

columns.name: line
columns.description: First line of the item.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The name as written.

columns.name: qualified
columns.description: The name with the inline `mod` blocks that enclose it; the file's own module path is `mount.module_path`, one per Cargo target that reaches the file.

columns.name: alias
columns.description: For a type alias, its right-hand side as written; empty for a struct or enum.

columns.name: declaration
columns.description: The lexical `declaration.id` at the same file, line and name; empty if none matched.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: In a test-only file, a test module, or behind a test gate. Always false unless the capture includes tests (`--with-tests`).

relations.name: field
relations.description: A field of a workspace struct or enum, with its type as written.

columns.name: type
columns.description: The type (`type.id`).

columns.name: position
columns.description: Position among the type's fields, from 0.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The field name, or its position for a tuple field.

columns.name: written
columns.description: The field's type as written.

relations.name: call
relations.description: A call whose target Atlas resolved to exactly one workspace function.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: from
columns.description: The calling function (`function.id`).

columns.name: to
columns.description: The called function (`function.id`).

columns.name: path
columns.description: File of the call site.

columns.name: line
columns.description: Line of the call site.

columns.name: column
columns.description: Column of the call site.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: The call is test code: its `from` item is `test_only`, or the call itself is under a test gate or in a test module. Always false unless the capture includes tests (`--with-tests`).

notes: Only unique resolutions: an ambiguous or unresolved call is an `unknown_call` row, never a `call` row.
Calls inside macro arguments are not observed; a closure's or `async` block's calls are its enclosing function's.

relations.name: unknown_call
relations.description: A call Atlas could not resolve to exactly one workspace function: external, ambiguous or unsupported.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: from
columns.description: The calling function (`function.id`).

columns.name: spelling
columns.description: The callee as written.

columns.name: receiver
columns.description: The method receiver as written, or empty for a path call.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why the call is unresolved, as Atlas reports it.

columns.name: path
columns.description: File of the call site.

columns.name: line
columns.description: Line of the call site.

columns.name: column
columns.description: Column of the call site.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Each reason's stable kind, such as `unresolved-path`, joined with `; ` like `reason`.

columns.name: subject
columns.description: Each reason's path, name, receiver, type or module, or empty, joined the same way.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: The call is test code: its `from` item is `test_only`, or the call itself is under a test gate or in a test module. Always false unless the capture includes tests (`--with-tests`).

notes: Includes calls into other crates and the standard library; an unknown call is not a missing call.

relations.name: reference
relations.description: A signature or field type that names exactly one workspace type.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: from
columns.description: The function or type whose signature or field it is.

columns.name: to
columns.description: The named type (`type.id`).

columns.name: role
columns.description: input, output, field or alias-target.

columns.name: slot
columns.description: The parameter, return or field it occupies.

columns.name: expression
columns.description: The entire written type, such as `Arc<Graph>`.

columns.name: line
columns.description: Line of the written type.

columns.name: borrow
columns.description: The written type is a reference.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: The `from` item is `test_only`: the observation is in test code. Always false unless the capture includes tests (`--with-tests`).

notes: `Arc<Graph>` is a reference to Graph, not a claim that the function owns one.

relations.name: unknown_type
relations.description: A type spelling in a signature or field that Atlas did not resolve to one workspace type.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: from
columns.description: The function or type whose signature or field it is.

columns.name: spelling
columns.description: The type as written.

columns.name: role
columns.description: input, output, field or alias-target.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why it is unresolved, as Atlas reports it.

columns.name: slot
columns.description: The parameter, return or field it occupies.

columns.name: line
columns.description: Line of the spelling.

columns.name: column
columns.description: Column of the spelling, 1-based.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: The `from` item is `test_only`: the observation is in test code. Always false unless the capture includes tests (`--with-tests`).

notes: Each mention is its own row: a generic argument such as the `u32` in `Vec<u32>` is a row of its own beside `Vec<u32>`.

relations.name: construction
relations.description: A struct literal or enum variant of a workspace type built in a function body.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: from
columns.description: The function (`function.id`).

columns.name: to
columns.description: The type built (`type.id`).

columns.name: line
columns.description: Line of the construction.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: The `from` item is `test_only`: the observation is in test code. Always false unless the capture includes tests (`--with-tests`).

relations.name: default_call
relations.description: An explicit zero-argument `Type::default()` call for a workspace type.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: from
columns.description: The function (`function.id`).

columns.name: to
columns.description: The type (`type.id`).

columns.name: line
columns.description: Line of the call.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: The `from` item is `test_only`: the observation is in test code. Always false unless the capture includes tests (`--with-tests`).

relations.name: constant
relations.description: A written `const` item and its value as syntax; nothing is evaluated.

columns.name: id
columns.description: `path::modules::NAME`, unique within one export.

columns.name: path
columns.description: The file.

columns.name: line
columns.description: Line of the item.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The constant's name.

columns.name: inline_modules
columns.description: Enclosing inline `mod` blocks, joined with `::`; empty at file level.

columns.name: value
columns.description: The value as JSON: `{"kind": ..., "value": ...}` with kind string, array, tuple, path, call or opaque.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: In a test-only file, a test module, or behind a test gate. Always false unless the capture includes tests (`--with-tests`).

relations.name: semantic_call
relations.description: A recorded call that the SCIP index (a compiler front end's reading) names a workspace function for.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: from
columns.description: The calling function (`function.id`), or empty when no captured function is at the caller's site.

columns.name: to
columns.description: The function the index defines the callee at (`function.id`): the captured function whose file and line are the definition's.

columns.name: spelling
columns.description: The callee as written, as in `unknown_call`.

columns.name: path
columns.description: File of the call site, as in `call` and `unknown_call`, so the readings join on site and spelling (chained calls share a site).

columns.name: line
columns.description: Line of the call site.

columns.name: column
columns.description: Column of the call site.

columns.name: agreement
columns.description: How the qualified reading compares: `agrees` (the same function), `extends` (qualified named no workspace function), `disagrees` (they differ: a finding, reported, never resolved).

notes: One build configuration: the indexer's host target and default features; code inactive there has no reading.
Read only from an index the command is given (--scip FILE) or makes (--semantic); a semantic row is not a `call` row and is never merged into one.
A row requires the index's symbol to name what is written at the site; a stale index reads as `mismatch` in `semantic_unknown`.

relations.name: semantic_unknown
relations.description: A recorded call the SCIP index names no captured workspace function for.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: from
columns.description: The calling function (`function.id`), or empty.

columns.name: spelling
columns.description: The callee as written.

columns.name: path
columns.description: File of the call site.

columns.name: line
columns.description: Line of the call site.

columns.name: column
columns.description: Column of the call site.

columns.name: reading
columns.description: What the index says: `trait-method` (dispatch open), `external` (another package), `no-definition` (a workspace symbol defined nowhere: macro- or derive-generated, or inactive), `local` (a closure or function value), `ambiguous`, `mismatch` (the index names another symbol: made from other source), `not-indexed`, or `definition` (a definition with no captured function at its site).

columns.name: detail
columns.description: The trait declaration's site, the external package and item, the symbol, or the reason.

notes: A semantic unknown is not a missing call; the qualified `call` and `unknown_call` rows at the same site still stand.
